tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search upcoming social dance events (bachata, salsa, kizomba, zouk socials, parties and festivals) by meaning, in any language. The query may contain a place and a time, which are applied as exact filters: "bachata this weekend in Amsterdam", "salsa tonight Barcelona", "festivales de kizomba en prim

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Full details of one event: times, venue and address, price, line-up, description, `tickets` (a link that opens the organiser's ticket page), organiser links, other dates of a recurring night and other events nearby. Pass the `id` or the `url` from a search result (an abcdancer.com/events or events.a

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: The cities that have upcoming dance events in the calendar, most events first, with the count of upcoming events and the link to each city's page. Also the known dance styles. Coverage: Amsterdam and the rest of the Netherlands first, then Spain (Madrid, Barcelona), Belgium, Germany, France, Portuga

tools.name: upcoming
tools.description: Every listed event in a time window, in date and start-time order, optionally for one city, country, style or kind. Use it for "where can I dance tonight in Amsterdam?" or "what's on this weekend?". `when` is read in the local time of the city; "tonight" keeps showing the current night until 05:00.
